description.en: Returns what the first member of the party list (the character the player controls, as the scripts use it) has equipped in an equipment slot: the item's ID, or 0 for nothing.

The equipped item's ID, or 0 if the slot is empty or the player data is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Nothing equipped yet (real usage, from ev42010450.nut)
